'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***[[Yevgeny Prigozhin]], the head of the [[Wagner Group]], claims "legal control" of [[Bakhmut]], although [[Ukraine]] denies this, stating that its troops continue to remain in the city's western districts. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/03/ukraine-war-live-updates-latest-news-on-russia-and-the-war-in-ukraine.html (CNBC)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Lions' Den (militant group)|Lions' Den]] militant and a [[Fatah]] member are killed during a raid by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Nablus]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. Two other [[Palestinians]] are arrested and dozens more are hospitalized due to [[tear gas]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/3/israeli-forces-kill-two-palestinians-in-occupied-west-bank-raid-2 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[Brent crude]] oil prices increase by [[$]]4.30 to $84.19 per barrel after [[OPEC]] announces an unexpected reduction in the output of oil exports by about 1.16 million barrels per day. [[Petroleum in the United States|U.S. crude oil]] prices increase by $4.17 to $79.84 per barrel in response to the announcement. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2023/4/3/oil-prices-surge-after-opecs-surprise-output-cuts (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Acquisition of WWE by Endeavor]]
**[[Endeavor (company)|Endeavor Group Holdings]], owners of [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC), announce that they will acquire [[WWE|World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc.]] in a deal estimated to be worth US$9.3 billion. The two entities will be merged and spun off, with Endeavor controlling 51% of the combined company, and WWE shareholders controlling the remaining 49%. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/03/wwe-ufc-merger-endeavor.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Papua New Guinea earthquake]]
**A 7.1 magnitude [[earthquake]] strikes [[East Sepik Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]], killing eight people, injuring several others, and causing damage. [https://news.pngfacts.com/2023/04/a-child-among-eight-dead-in-pngs-east.html?m=1 (Papua New Guinea Today)]
*A magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes [[Kamchatka Krai]], [[Russia]], with damage reported in [[Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky]]. The [[Mutnovskaya Power Station]] is also temporarily shut down. [https://kam24.ru/news/main/20230403/96475.html (KAM24)]
*Four people are injured in a fire at a hospital in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. One person has been arrested on suspicion of arson. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-hospital-fire-afaa5d198977d88a1a7926c94e31b68c (AP)]
*Six people are killed and 64 others are missing after a boat capsizes in the [[Lake Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/six-dead-64-missing-after-boat-sinks-congos-lake-kivu-local-official-2023-04-03/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] announces a ban on [[Armenia]]n [[dairy]] imports amid a continued worsening of relations between the two countries. [https://eurasianet.org/russia-bans-armenian-dairy-as-relations-continue-to-sour (''Eurasianet'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artemis II]]
**[[NASA]] announces the four members of [[Artemis II]], the first crewed mission of the [[Artemis program]] which will send astronauts to the Moon for the first time since [[Apollo 17]]: [[Reid Wiseman]], [[Christina Koch]], [[Jeremy Hansen]], and [[Victor Glover]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2023/04/03/science/artemis-nasa-news#meet-the-four-astronauts-of-artemis-ii (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[National Hurricane Center]] releases a report announcing that [[Hurricane Ian]], which made landfall [[2022 Atlantic hurricane season|last year]] in most of [[Southwest Florida|southwest]] [[Florida]], has been reanalyzed and recategorized as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 5 hurricane]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2023/04/03/hurricane-ian-category-5/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[2022–23 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn Huskies]] rout the [[2022–23 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State Aztecs]] [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|76–59]] to win the championship, making it the fifth national championship for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|Huskies]]. [https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/36061720/uconn-completes-dominant-run-wins-fifth-national-title?platform=amp (ESPN)]
*[[2023 FIFA U-17 World Cup]]
**[[Peru]] is removed as a host for the [[FIFA U-17 World Cup]] after failing to meet the requirements for staging the tournament. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-fifa-u17-world-cup-7ac6d416db5812b653616bd3599b8d6a (AP)]
